text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Vivlos! Come over here!
It's so beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Vivlos... lend me your hand.
...See, can you see it?

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
So sparkly...!

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—I wanna see everyone's smiles.
Everyone that I love so much...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ――... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I... I love all of you
so much!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—In this year's "Japan Cup"!
The winner is...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos! It's Vivlos!
Defeating her formidable rivals,
she sweeps a blue wind through Tokyo!
(Uwooooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Vivlos-chan~~!
And Cheval-chan too! You both looked so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: "You truly are daughters to be proud of... And that includes you, Verxina, for paving the way ahead."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: For letting me be a big sister to those kids... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you for your cheering~~!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chi!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I was super happy I got to run with you!
It was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because you were with me, Cheva-chi,
I was able to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Because I wanna show you my cool side♡"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I saw it, clearly.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I was watching, too.
The whole time...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You really are... different from me.
You are, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed,
the way she has guts... might be similar, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Or... maybe it sounds rich
coming from someone who lost, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure people are gonna talk.
Saying stuff like, "The middle sister really is no good after all"...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!
That's not—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Fine.
Then... I'll just say it right back to them.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Just watch. I am...
a big sister to that girl, after all"... she said.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chi...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll go renew
my passport."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm coming along anyway, I don't just want to follow...
I want to run too."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup!
Let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy-poo~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, what am I like right now...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Nihehe!
Right?♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Now we can aim for it.
This time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Vivlos,
over here!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Together with my beloved family—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Together
with Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
To the sparkling
land of celebrities...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Shall we fly away together,
Trainy?♡
